# Diálogo de la Lengua — manuscript page 18

This fixture pairs page 18 of the sixteenth-century manuscript of Juan de
Valdés's *Diálogo de la Lengua* with DILE transcription rows 143–147.

- Facsimile source: Biblioteca Nacional de España, BNE Digital item
  `0a7090ca-7301-4aa0-a1e1-2ce5b6fb7c97` (formerly `bdh0000048928`).
- Page copy: <https://dile.dragoman.org/1/18.pdf>
- Page-aligned transcription: <https://dile.dragoman.org/tab.html#143>
- DILE TEI transcription: <https://dile.dragoman.org/s1.xml>
- DILE project director: M. T. Carrasco Benitez.
- Paleographic transcription: Alba Agraz Ortiz and Sara Sánchez Hernández.
